titleEn: Acupoints and acupuncture: how does the "Qi" of Eastern medicine relate to modern science?
summaryEn:
For centuries, traditional Eastern medicine has described the human body as a network of **meridians** carrying **Qi**, with hundreds of acupoints acting as points that regulate energy. Yet when dissecting the human body, scientists have not found any physical structure resembling the "meridians" described in the ancient medical texts.

So do acupoints really exist? And how does acupuncture work from the standpoint of modern science?
